prompt: Five Nights at Freddy's initial game release came one day short of the 19 year anniversary of the death of which Grateful Dead band member?
answer: Jerry Garcia. *Five Nights at Freddy’s* was initially released on August 8, 2014—one day before the 19th anniversary of Garcia’s death on August 9, 1995.
